column1: # rule_seam_bindings.tsv — the rule-to-seam binding registry (FR-010 / FR-011 / FR-018).
# Schema (TAB-separated, exactly three fields):
#     <rule-anchor>\t<seam-id>\t<gate-token>
# Consumed by: scripts/gates/cm_rule_binds_to_seam.sh
# The BARE DOTTED anchor id — `11.4.187`, `12.12` — with NO leading section
# sign. This is deliberate (§11.4.201(7)(c) — the encoding is part of the
# instrument): `§` is two UTF-8 bytes (0xC2 0xA7), and a registry keyed on it
# resolves by absence the moment any producer writes it as Latin-1, as an
# HTML entity, or splits it across a byte-boundary. The bare dotted id is
# pure ASCII and cannot mis-compare. It matches the key convention already
# used by covenant_propagation_anchors.tsv field 2.
# CLOSED SET, restated here byte-for-byte from the E5 table in
# specs/002-anti-slop-enforcement/data-model.md. A near-miss id resolves BY
# ABSENCE and silently voids the lookup, so the set is restated in this file
# rather than only referenced:
#     pre-action
#     commit
#     pre-build
#     release-tag
#     qa-deploy
#     manual-qa-handoff
# No other value is legal. `deploy` is NOT `qa-deploy`; `prebuild` is NOT
# `pre-build`. cm_rule_binds_to_seam.sh REFUSES a row carrying an id outside
# this set rather than treating it as an unlisted-and-therefore-instance
# seam — that fail-open rule (seam-tier-table.md) governs the TIER axis, not
# the SPELLING axis, and applying it here would convert every typo into a
# silent pass.
# The CM-* token of the gate that performs the refusal at that seam. The gate
# must have an executable gate site on disk — a token named here with no
# executable site is a prose carrier and NEVER counts (§11.4.227(A)).
# The normalised (seam-id, gate-token) PAIR is the restatement key. Two rules
# claiming the same pair means the second restates the first, and the
# declaring change is refused with the covering rule NAMED. Honest boundary
# (§11.4.6): pair-collision is the DECIDABLE projection of restatement.
# Semantic overlap outside it — two rules that mean the same thing while
# binding different pairs — remains §11.4.142/§11.4.194 review territory and
# is NOT claimed to be covered here.
# Every row below was MEASURED on this tree, not asserted:
#   * `11.4.187 / pre-build / CM-MULTITRACK-ENGINE-IN-CONSTITUTION` — the gate
#     basename appears on a non-comment line of
#     device/rockchip/rk3588/tests/pre_build_verification.sh (literal
#     invocation, measured 2026-08-21 with a control needle proving the scan
#     was not blind).
#   * every `CM-COVENANT-114-*-PROPAGATION` row — data-dispatch bound: the
#     gate path is CONSTRUCTED by covenant_propagation_suite.sh:93 from a row
#     in covenant_propagation_anchors.tsv, and that suite is invoked from
#     pre_build_verification.sh:43844. Each row below therefore exists in
#     covenant_propagation_anchors.tsv; the 17 wrappers on disk with no
#     anchors row are DELIBERATELY absent here, because they are genuinely
#     unbound today (that is the T029/T030 deficit, not a registry gap).
# Classification: universal (§11.4.17) — consumer-owned DATA per §11.4.35.
# rule-anchor
